$comment: ADR-001 L1 allow-list — controllers that legitimately operate without TenantGuard. Every entry requires explicit reason + addedBy (commit SHA or session-plan ref). Reviewed at every epic RETRO per governance/EXECUTION_PROTOCOL §14.

skipTenantControllers.reason: pre-tenant resolution — login/refresh/logout endpoints. Uses @SkipTenant() on routes that don't yet have tenant context.
infrastructure health endpoint — no tenant scope; called by load balancers.
platform-admin tooling (site analyzer, screenshot, debug) — uses @SkipTenant() at class level. Platform-scope guard implied.
public read-only tenant lookup by slug — resolves tenant from URL slug rather than enforcing one from JWT. Uses @SkipTenant() on bootstrap and public-read paths.
public menu rendering — tenant resolved from slug param; @SkipTenant() on read-only public endpoints.
global Class-G catalog (no tenant_id, ADR-008 carve-out) — platform-level resource managed by admin, published to tenants via snapshots (ADR-009). @SkipTenant() at class level.

rawQueryAllow.reason: pre-tenant resolution — login flow needs to look up user before tenant context exists. ADR-001B (L2 detector) will check this is the only such case.
